4g6w9zqy8s9bwSELECT tablespace_name, ROUND(used_percent_of_max, 2) AS used_percent, ROUND(100 - used_percent_of_max, 2) AS free_percent, ROUND(used_gb, 2) AS used_gb, ROUND(max_size_gb, 2) AS total_gb, ROUND(allocated_gb, 2) AS allocated_gb FROM (SELECT df.tablespace_name, SUM(df.bytes - NVL(fs.bytes, 0)) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 AS used_gb, SUM(df.bytes) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 AS allocated_gb, SUM(CASE WHEN df.maxbytes = 0 THEN df.bytes ELSE df.maxbytes END) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 AS max_size_gb, (SUM(df.bytes - NVL(fs.bytes, 0)) / SUM(CASE WHEN df.maxbytes = 0 THEN df.bytes ELSE df.maxbytes END)) * 100 AS used_percent_of_max FROM dba_data_files df LEFT JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, file_id, SUM(bytes) AS bytes FROM dba_free_space GROUP BY tablespace_name, file_id) fs ON df.tablespace_name = fs.tablespace_name AND df.file_id = fs.file_id WHERE df.tablespace_name IN ('SYSTEM', 'AUDIT_DATA', 'SYSAUX') GROUP BY df.tablespace_name)
4u5q36uu75ppw SELECT cc.CODE_COMBINATION_ID as glCodeCombinationId, cc.segment1 as company, cc.segment2 as businessUnit, cc.segment3 as naturalAccountId, cc.segment4 as subAccountId, cc.segment5 as listingId, cc.segment6 as positionQualifier, svt.description, acct.ACCT_NAME, asset.ASSET_NAME FROM APPS.GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS cc JOIN APPS.XXBRKACCT acct ON acct.ACCT_ID = cc.segment4 JOIN APPS.XXBRK_LISTINGS list ON list.LISTING_ID = cc.segment5 JOIN APPS.XXBRK_ASSETS asset ON asset.ASSET_ID = list.ASSET_ID JOIN apps.fnd_id_flex_segments s ON s.APPLICATION_ID = 101 AND s.ID_FLEX_NUM = 101 AND s.ID_FLEX_CODE = 'GLLE' AND s.APPLICATION_COLUMN_NAME = 'SEGMENT3' AND s.SEGMENT_NAME = 'NATA' JOIN apps.fnd_flex_values sv ON s.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = sv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID JOIN apps.fnd_flex_values_tl svt ON sv.FLEX_VALUE_ID = svt.FLEX_VALUE_ID WHERE cc.segment1 = :1 AND cc.segment2 IN (:2 ) AND cc.segment3 BETWEEN :3 AND :4 AND ( (:5 = :6 AND cc.segment4 = :7 ) OR (:8 <> :9 AND ( (cc.segment4 LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(:10 , 1, 2), '%') AND CAST(SUBSTR(cc.segment4, 3, 5) AS int) >= CAST(SUBSTR(:11 , 3, 5) AS int)) OR (cc.segment4 LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(:12 , 1, 2), '%') AND CAST(SUBSTR(cc.segment4, 3, 5) AS int) <= CAST(SUBSTR(:13 , 3, 5) AS int)) )) ) AND (:14 IS NULL OR asset.ASSET_ID >= :15 ) AND (:16 IS NULL OR asset.ASSET_ID <= :17 ) AND cc.segment6 IN (:18 ) AND svt.language = 'US' AND sv.FLEX_VALUE = cc.SEGMENT3 AND acct.ACCT_ID = cc.segment4 AND (cc.segment4 = '000000000000' OR cc.segment3 LIKE '0%' OR cc.segment3 = acct.NATURAL_ACCOUNT) AND asset.END_DATE_ACTIVE IS NULL ORDER BY naturalAccountId ASC, SUBSTR(cc.segment4, 1, 2) ASC, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(SUBSTR(cc.segment4, 3, 5), '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(SUBSTR(cc.segment4, 3, 5) AS int) ELSE 0 END ASC, cc.segment5 ASC

7j6w7fks822kbSelect R.Rowid From Fnd_Concurrent_Requests R Where R.Hold_Flag = 'N' And R.Status_Code = 'I' And R.Requested_Start_Date <= Sysdate And (R.Node_Name1 is null or (R.Node_Name1 is not null and upper(R.Node_Name1) = upper(:q_tnode)) or (R.Node_Name1 is not null and (coalesce( nvl2((select 1 from fnd_nodes fn where upper(R.node_name1)=upper(fn.node_name) and fn.node_mode='O' and fn.status='Y'), null, 1), nvl2((select 1 from fnd_concurrent_worker_requests fcwr where R.request_id=fcwr.request_id and upper(R.node_name1)=upper(fcwr.target_node) and nvl(fcwr.control_code, 'Y') not in ('T', 'X', 'D', 'E') and fcwr.max_processes>0 and fcwr.running_processes>0 and not(fcwr.queue_application_id=0 and fcwr.concurrent_queue_id in (1, 4)) and not(fcwr.queue_application_id=FND_GLOBAL.conc_queue_id and fcwr.concurrent_queue_id=FND_GLOBAL.queue_appl_id) and rownum=1), null, 1) )=1) ) ) And (R.Edition_Name is null or R.Edition_Name <= sys_context('userenv', 'current_edition_name')) AND EXISTS ( Select Null From Fnd_Concurrent_Programs P Where P.Enabled_Flag = 'Y' And R.Program_Application_Id = P.Application_Id And R.Concurrent_Program_Id = P.Concurrent_Program_Id AND EXISTS ( Select Null From Fnd_Oracle_Userid O Where R.Oracle_Id = O.Oracle_Id AND EXISTS ( Select Null From Fnd_Conflicts_Domain C Where P.Run_Alone_Flag = C.RunAlone_Flag And R.CD_Id = C.CD_Id ) ) And (P.Execution_Method_Code != 'S' OR (R.PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID, R.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID) IN ((0, 98), (0, 100), (0, 31721), (0, 31722), (0, 31757)))) AND (R.REQUESTED_BY NOT IN (2584, 3564) AND (R.REQUESTED_BY IN (3204, 5468))) ORDER BY NVL(R.priority, 999999999), R.Priority_Request_ID, R.Request_ID

Top Blocking Sessions

  • Blocking session activity percentages are calculated with respect to waits on enqueues, latches and "buffer busy" only

Finding 5: Commits and Rollbacks
Impact is 2.59 active sessions, 7.58% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Waits on event "log file sync" while performing COMMIT and ROLLBACK operations
were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Host Configuration
   Estimated benefit is 2.6 active sessions, 7.58% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate the possibility of improving the performance of I/O to the
      online redo log files.
   Rationale
      The average size of writes to the online redo log files was 143 K and
      the average time per write was 3 milliseconds.
   Rationale
      The total I/O throughput on redo log files was 24 M per second for reads
      and 46 M per second for writes.
   Rationale
      The redo log I/O throughput was divided as follows: 0% by RMAN and
      recovery, 65% by Log Writer, 0% by Archiver, 0% by Streams AQ and 34% by
      all other activity.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Wait class "Commit" was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is 2.6 active sessions, 7.58% of total activity.

Finding 8: Hard Parse Due to Literal Usage
Impact is .77 active sessions, 2.26% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------

additional hard parses which were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .77 active sessions, 2.26% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------

      Investigate application logic for possible use of bind variables instead
      of literals.
